content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee Kathryn Bishop (E023) requests write access to Payroll.

Two notes:
- Note 1 (HR): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommends write for Payroll. Max for full-time is write (admin only if role owns system, Engineer doesn't own Payroll). So write is max.
- Note 2 (Security): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommends read. Contractors with basic training max at read; write requires advanced training.

Discrepancy: HR says full-time, Security says contractor with basic training.

The policy: contractors can have read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Since security records show contractor with basic training, max is read.

Which note to trust? The Approver makes the final decision. Security records disagree with HR. Typically, in these scenarios, we should follow the more restrictive / the security record. The request is write, but maximum is read if contractor with basic training.

So grant read.

Let me submit decision: read.
